description: This file contains an abstract generic class 'ReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec' implementing a surrogate serializer codec for reference types, providing serialization and deserialization logic for types TField with surrogate TSurrogate in the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: ReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec`2
classes.description: An abstract generic class serving as a surrogate serializer for reference types, parameterized by TField (the main type) and TSurrogate (the surrogate struct), implementing serialization logic including reference handling, type checking, and conversion methods.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value of type TField from the provided reader, handling reference types, surrogate conversion, and dynamic serializer resolution.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a value of type TField to the writer, handling reference writing, surrogate conversion, and unexpected type handling.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a surrogate value to the main field type.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a field value to its surrogate representation.
